mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 6.0% indicates a deteriorating labor market, which typically triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past month indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer and housing demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production (INDPRO > 105), a further increase in industrial output signals sustained economic strength, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 105 and INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 235 indicates persistent inflationary pressures, which typically lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a weakening labor market, which typically triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which typically generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100 indicates a contraction in the industrial sector, which typically triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
